Task: Melting of SiO2 - Level 1
Description: Simulate the melting of alpha quartz SiO2 by heating under NPT conditions using the Tersoff potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Compute the mean squared displacement (MSD) of all atoms using the MDAnalysis library. Identify the melting point as the first frame where the MSD shows a sudden jump, ignoring the first 500 ps of simulation. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state using the MSD after the detected melting point, and report the average value in m²/s.

numerical value without units (eg. 1.45e-10)

All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/.

3. Now let's create the LAMMPS input script. We need to write a script that will:
- Set up the simulation with proper units and atom style
- Read the data file
- Replicate the system 3x3x3
- Set up the Tersoff potential
- Run NPT heating simulation
- Output necessary trajectory and thermodynamic data

function.name: write_file

{"path": "/results/claude_35/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/sio2_melting_1_trial_1/in.melting", "content": "units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data sio2.data

replicate 3 3 3

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SiO.tersoff Si O

timestep 0.001

compute msd all msd com yes
variable temp equal temp
variable press equal press
variable vol equal vol
variable pe equal pe

thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol pe c_msd[4]

dump 1 all custom 100 traj.lammpstrj id type x y z

velocity all create 1500.0 12345 dist gaussian

fix 1 all npt temp 1500.0 5000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

dump myDump all custom 1000 dump.atom id type x y z vx vy vz
dump_modify myDump sort id

run 1000000"}
